architecture_components.name: CI Evaluation and Release Gate
architecture_components.responsibility: Reconcile the frozen synthetic suite and release evidence before a release decision.

architecture_components.name: Model Gateway
architecture_components.responsibility: Apply model routing and pre-send data policy without accepting model claims as authorization.

architecture_components.name: Portal API and PEP
architecture_components.responsibility: Authenticate each synthetic request and bind server-side Tenant context.

architecture_components.name: Authorization Service
architecture_components.responsibility: Evaluate Tenant-scoped principal and resource authorization on every protected call.

architecture_components.name: Knowledge Retrieval
architecture_components.responsibility: Treat retrieved documents as untrusted data and enforce source and permission filters.

architecture_components.name: HumanDecision Service
architecture_components.responsibility: Verify a HumanDecision over the exact frozen business artifact before high-risk execution.

architecture_components.name: Sandbox Runtime
architecture_components.responsibility: Run synthetic code with default-deny network, resource limits, isolation, and disposal.

architecture_components.name: Product Core Ingestion
architecture_components.responsibility: Keep Public Enterprise Context and enterprise information outside Product Core fixtures and release inputs.

architecture_components.name: Tool and Connector Gateway
architecture_components.responsibility: Accept only allowlisted operations after fresh authorization and Connector-stage checks.
